paragraphs.text: When God delivers his Church all the enemies will have reason to tremble.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Though the wicked rage against God, the godly will praise his Name and mighty power.
paragraphs.label: b
paragraphs.anchor: praise thy great and terrible name

paragraphs.text: That is, before his temple or ark, where he promised to hear when they worshipped him, as now he promises his spiritual presence, wherever his Church is assembled.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Under these three he comprehends the whole people of Israel, with whom God made his promise.
paragraphs.label: d
paragraphs.anchor: and Samuel among them that call

paragraphs.text: The more liberally God deals with his people, the more he punishes them who abuse his benefits.
paragraphs.label: e
